purposes: One neuron: a linear fit ŷ = wx + b trained by gradient descent on the squared error.
Feature normalization: each of three features is centred by its mean and scaled by its spread, every position on its own.
Dot product: a weighted sum s = ∑ wᵢxᵢ, one multiply per pair and one running sum.
Matrix multiply: every cell of C is a dot product, the row of A with the column of B, summed over k.
Softmax: turn a vector of scores into probabilities, each score exponentiated and divided by the sum of all of them.
Image normalization: the feature stone's rule lifted over a 4×4×3 image, the per-channel means and spreads broadcast by an index projection, never copied.
Convolution: every output cell is a weighted sum over a small window of the input, the same kernel slid over every position.
Sigmoid neuron: ŷ = σ(wx + b), a logistic fit trained by gradient descent on the squared error, through the squashing function.
Attention: every query scores every key, the scores become probabilities, and each output is the values averaged with those probabilities; two matrix products and a softmax.
Adam: gradient descent with a memory, a running mean of the gradient and of its square, so every step has about the same size whatever the gradient's scale.
